summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are at the party venue hosted by Kogoro's client, Shuji Sasano, the second president of Sasano Finance. Sasano had received a death threat. Apparently, the three guests who came to the venue had a grudge against the president. Later, Sasano collapses after drinking a glass of wine. He was poisoned.

suspects: Shintaro Toki, Terumi Hanaoka, Akira Enoshima, Kimiyuki Tachikawa, and Nanase Oizumi
